mapper.sql: record_id, key_id, user_id, user_name, key_name, encryt_type, encryt_name, distribute_type, distribute_status, distribute_time, chain_hash, block_height, remark, cre_time, upd_time
mapper.select: select count(*) as total_records, ifnull(sum(case when distribute_time >= curdate() then 1 else 0 end), 0) as today_records, ifnull(sum(case when ifnull(chain_hash, '') != '' or block_height is not null then 1 else 0 end), 0) as chain_completed_records, ifnull(sum(case when remark like '上链失败%' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as chain_failed_records from key_distribute_record where 1 = 1

select date_format(distribute_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as stat_date, count(*) as total_count, ifnull(sum(case when ifnull(chain_hash, '') != '' or block_height is not null then 1 else 0 end), 0) as chain_completed_count, ifnull(sum(case when remark like '上链失败%' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as chain_failed_count from key_distribute_record where distribute_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval #{days} day) and distribute_time < date_add(curdate(), interval 1 day)
group by date_format(distribute_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by stat_date asc

select case distribute_type when '1' then '生成分发' when '2' then '更新分发' when '3' then '回收后补发' else '未知类型' end as label, count(*) as value from key_distribute_record where distribute_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval #{days} day) and distribute_time < date_add(curdate(), interval 1 day)
group by distribute_type order by value desc

select case when encryt_name is null or trim(encryt_name) = '' then '未知算法' else encryt_name end as label, count(*) as value from key_distribute_record where distribute_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval #{days} day) and distribute_time < date_add(curdate(), interval 1 day)
group by label order by value desc limit 6

select from key_distribute_record where remark like '上链失败%'
order by ifnull(upd_time, distribute_time) desc, record_id desc limit #{limit}

select from key_distribute_record where (ifnull(chain_hash, '') != '' or block_height is not null)
order by ifnull(upd_time, distribute_time) desc, record_id desc limit #{limit}
